normalInitial:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: exactly ONE contact sheet containing FIVE separate third-person pixel-art game scenes for a Korean life simulation. This is an asset style review sheet, not a game UI.
Layout: landscape canvas 2:1. Exactly five equally sized rectangular 4:3 panels: THREE panels across the upper row, TWO panels centered across the lower row. No sixth image. The two unused lower corners must be solid warm paper #F7F4EE. Panels must not merge into a continuous panorama. Full scene visible within each panel, not cropped. No labels, captions, numbers, titles, UI, or film perforations anywhere. Each scene should read as a native 300x225 pixel artwork, optionally displayed at an exact nearest-neighbor enlargement (conceptually canvas 1800x900 for 2x display of five 300x225 panels). Use visible square pixel clusters; no high-resolution painted illustration masquerading as pixel art.

Panel order, left-to-right upper row then lower row:
1. Childhood friendship: a small gender-neutral child playing tag with two friends at a Korean neighborhood playground at sunset. Small full-body figures, slide and swings, distant modest apartment windows with lights. Safe ordinary play, warm restrained ochre colors. No jumping from heights.
2. Teenage study: small full-body or seated-body teenage student from behind at a partitioned study-room desk at night. Desk lamp, open blank notebook, plain unmarked sticky notes on partition, quiet concentration. Clear silhouette against muted navy and warm lamplight.
3. Teenage part-time job: gender-neutral student in plain apron standing behind convenience-store counter at night, handing a plain shopping bag to a customer. Neutral product shapes on shelves, dark street beyond glass. No branded storefront, no alcohol or tobacco emphasis.
4. Young-adult adventure: gender-neutral young adult with a backpack, full figure visible, pausing to look at a folded unlettered map in an unfamiliar ordinary city alley at dusk. Small blank shop sign shapes, muted brick and dusty teal; no landmark, flag or readable signage.
5. Middle-age hobby: gender-neutral middle-aged protagonist on apartment balcony beside a camping chair, fishing rod, camera and neatly stacked unmarked delivery boxes, quietly proud relaxed stance in calm afternoon light. Full figure and setting visible, no logo or shipping label.

Shared style: authentic coarse 16-bit-style pixel-art backgrounds and simple small character sprites, crisp grid-aligned edges, flat discrete color clusters and 2-3 shade steps, a coherent limited palette with no more than approximately 40 colors across the artwork, absolutely NO dithering, stippling, grain, checkerboard shading or texture noise. Restrained vintage-film mood compatible with warm paper UI: faded ochre, muted brown, desaturated olive, dusty blue, warm cream, soft charcoal. Light must be shown using flat color shapes, NO gradients, bloom, blur, smooth shading, soft photographic vignette, anti-aliased outlines, glossy 3D lighting, neon colors, photorealism, webtoon/vector art or watercolor. No emojis, watermark, lettering, numbers, recognizable logos, brands, school/company badges, film frames, border decoration or UI. Notes, packaging, maps and signs are blank color shapes. Same visual language in all five panels.

pov:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: exactly ONE contact sheet containing THREE separate first-person POV pixel-art scenes for decisions/incidents in a Korean life simulation. This is an asset style review sheet, not a game UI.
Layout: overall landscape 4:3 canvas. TWO equally sized 4:3 panels across the top row, ONE equal-sized 4:3 panel centered beneath. Exactly three images, no fourth. The two unused bottom corners are solid warm paper #F7F4EE. Each scene should read as native 300x225 pixel artwork, optionally displayed at an exact nearest-neighbor 2x enlargement (conceptually overall canvas 1200x900). Keep each panel independent and all important elements visible inside its 4:3 boundary. No labels, numbers, captions, titles, UI, borders, film frames or perforations.

Panel order: upper left, upper right, bottom center.
1. Exam at school: true eye-level first-person view from the seated student's own desk. Foreground own hands, one naturally holding a pencil beside a face-down blank exam sheet on the wooden desktop. Back of a student seated at the desk ahead, chalkboard and a clock with a completely unnumbered face in the background. Quiet tense but safe daytime classroom. No viewer face, no outside view of the protagonist, no exam questions or answers, no cheating, no uniform emblem.
2. Feverish morning: true first-person view lying in bed, looking past a modest blanket toward the ceiling and a little bedside table. Own hand emerges from the blanket holding a plain thermometer with an unmarked display. Plain smartphone on bedside table has a blank muted illuminated screen, glass of water. Soft early-morning desaturated blue and cream rendered entirely as flat pixel colors. Suggest feeling unwell through posture and setting only. No visible protagonist face, body viewed from outside, blood, needles, hospital equipment, ambulance, skeleton, death implication, screen digits or medical text.
3. Office entrance refuses access: true first-person view standing directly before an ordinary office lobby turnstile. Foreground own hand taps a blank ID badge on a reader whose small red indicator light is on. Gate stays closed; two small coworkers in the middle distance pass through other gates. Restrained cool morning lobby, quiet disappointment rather than dramatic danger. No viewer face, brand/company name, badge text, reader message, aggressive guards or forced eviction.

Shared style: authentic coarse 16-bit-style pixel art, deliberately simplified hands, crisp grid-aligned square pixels, recognizable environments, no excess micro-detail. Coherent limited palette, approximately 40 colors or fewer; discrete flat shade blocks only. Absolutely no dithering, stippling, grain, checkerboard shading or noise. Calm muted vintage-film tone using warm cream, faded brown, desaturated navy, dusty teal, olive and charcoal, only a tiny subdued red gate indicator. NO gradients, blur, bloom, soft photographic vignette, anti-aliased outlines, smooth vector art, photorealism, 3D render, webtoon or watercolor. No emojis, watermark, readable text, numbers, logos, branding, UI or film-frame decoration anywhere. Screens, paper, clock faces and ID badges remain unlettered. Hands and viewpoint must clearly belong to the viewer; do not show the viewer from third person. Same pixel-art language across all three panels.
